description: Displays validation and generation issues for a modeling document.

parameters.name: Issues
parameters.description: Issues to render, in input order. Severity only colors the rows — the panel never re-sorts the list (severity filtering/sorting is backlog). Issues without a SourceElementId/SourceRelationshipId render as non-interactive list items; navigable issues render as buttons.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

parameters.name: OnIssueSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an issue that points to a model element or relationship.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__count
cssClasses.description: Count-only badge in the header: visible text is the bare count, the localized formulation is the aria-label.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__severity
cssClasses.description: Severity label in the row meta, tinted with the severity text token (`--severity--{info|warning|error}`).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__fix
cssClasses.description: Suggested-fix toned box (primary subtle tokens) holding the icon, the localized prefix label and the fix text.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__chevron
cssClasses.description: Navigation chevron rendered only inside navigable issue buttons (TmIcon ChevronRight), aria-hidden.
